CENTRAL CRIMINAL COURT, OLD BAILEY // THE KING v. JOHN CLAY & DUNCAN ROSS.
1. Person John Clay [ID:P511] is named as Prime Accused and mastermind of the subterranean vault intrusion.
2. Person John Clay [ID:P511] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-CLAY-DISGUISE].
3. Charges framed under Section 420 (Cheating by Impersonation) and Section 457 (Lurking House-Trespass by Night for Bank Burglary).
4. Person Duncan Ross [ID:P512] is named as Co-Accused and manager of the dummy Red-Headed League office.
5. Person Duncan Ross [ID:P512] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-REDLEAGUE-OFFICE].
6. Person Jabez Wilson [ID:P513] is referenced in this case as an exploited pawn and witness.
7. Person Jabez Wilson [ID:P513] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-PAWNSHOP-WILSON].
8. Person Peter Jones [ID:P515] is referenced as a witness and official police inspector of Scotland Yard.
9. Prosecution proves Accused P511 wired $180,000 in French gold coins from Account 010 / ACC-CLAY-DISGUISE into Account 010 / ACC-REDLEAGUE-OFFICE to finance tunneling operations.
